## Deloitte at Innovation UK 2026

Deloitte is proud to be a gold sponsor of Innovation 2026, where government leaders come together to discuss shared challenges and how innovation is being delivered in practice. Governments globally are increasingly finding that innovation provides the key to addressing these dynamic challenges. This involves adopting emerging technologies, adapting to evolving cultures, and developing new skills, structures, and communication methods to effectively meet the public’s evolving expectations.
